title_or_table: Congress.gov API, bills of the 119th Congress with the policy area Housing and Community Development that moved past referral, from the bill lists of the Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs and the House Committee on Financial Services
universe_or_base: Eight bills chosen by the studio from the 276 housing bills found in those committee lists: every one that had moved past referral to committee, with H.R. 4646 left out because its title is not about housing
vintage: Congress.gov data as served on November 11, 2026
qualification: A tracker list shows where each bill stands on one date; housing provisions also ride in larger bills that these committee lists do not catch, and S. 2651's ideas may have moved in H.R. 6644, which the record here does not show. Sponsors are named with their party in words as the record gives them

status.description: stage, in the studio's words, from the latest action

hearing_recorded.description: whether Congress.gov records a committee or subcommittee hearing on this bill (a "Hearings By" activity); false means none is recorded on the bill, not that no hearing on the subject was held

committee_record.description: each committee activity Congress.gov records for the bill, with its date (referred, markup, reported, discharged, reported as an original measure)

committee_vote.description: date and tally of the committee vote to report the bill, from its actions; empty where none is recorded

first_chamber_passed.description: date the chamber where the bill began passed it

second_chamber_passed.description: date the other chamber first passed it (later votes resolving differences are in the actions)

printed_source_line: Source: Library of Congress, Congress.gov, housing bills in the 119th Congress, status as of November 11, 2026, United States Congress. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Eight bills that moved past committee referral; status words are Oath & Action’s.
notes: Committee steps added November 12, 2026 (fix pass 2, maker A’s A6) from each bill’s actions and committee activities on the Congress.gov API. Congress.gov records no hearing on any of the eight bills; a hearing on a subject or a draft, with no bill number, would not show.
